state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stages 2 and 3 are done, and Stage 4 is under way.** The `codes!` macro in
`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` reads an optional `.card("…")` after each `Code::new(…)` and
writes `code::card(code) -> Option<&'static str>` beside `code::ALL`. The ten lexer codes
`E0001`–`E0010` carry cards; every other code is in the test module's `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, in
declaration order, and `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` holds the two together both ways.
`nvs agent show E0007` prints a code's card.

`Renderer::render_all` closes every run that rendered a coded diagnostic with the constant
`AGENT_SHOW_LINE` ("To read what a code means and how to fix it, run `nvs agent show <code>`."), after
the summary, warnings-only runs included. Every `.nvst` case that pins the summary pins that line too.
The rule's terminal half is shipped; its card half waits on the list emptying. Stage 5 is not started.

next.title: every diagnostic code carries its card

items.text: **Drain the list, one band per session, in file order** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; the parser band starts at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:194` (`E0101`). A card is one to three sentences for the person who met the error, in the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. Read the `///` above the code and the site that raises it, never only the constant's name — a delegated `Explore` search for each band's raise sites (`file.rs:NN` per code) keeps that reading out of the session. Delete each code from `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4090` in the same commit. The first sentence becomes the index line, so it must read alone.

**`no_code_still_owes_a_card`** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; add it beside `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4140` in the session that deletes the last entry from `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, as an assertion that the list is empty.
